subject: Handover note: TM-2026-0094
body:
Claim TM-2026-0094 (E. Tanaka, Policy TM-HH-620338)

Status: Closed

This household storm claim was settled and closed on 4 March 2026 following roof damage from named storm conditions on 18 January 2026. Repairs comprised scaffold, tile replacement and internal making good. Total paid: £4,820.

A boundary fence element was declined as storm damage to fences falls outside cover.

No outstanding matters.

Best regards
A. Wrenfield
